limitations: Shared native S3 read ACL does not inherit parent restriction
Shared projection currently textures only, no canonical USDZ/by-name
Manifest refresh and client caches delay changes
Single bridge replica on cloud OPAL node
No dedicated Nucleus Manager dependency card

incident.trigger: Malformed exploratory get_acl_v2 request with string paths appears to have crashed the native API. Correct schema uses objects with path and trailing slash for directories.
incident.recovery: Kubernetes restarted the API; standard launcher archived, checked and repaired metadata; service recovered. Root listing and small/large reads subsequently passed.
